subject: Saturday plans
text:
Hi,

Are you free to walk around the market Saturday morning? I know your schedule is crowded, so maybe Sunday would work better if Saturday feels too rushed. I also noticed a good book table just past the fruit stalls.

If you prefer, we could meet at the quieter café near the library and keep the visit short.

Let me know what suits you, and I can adjust. No pressure if another week is better.
